title: Daily AI Newsletter Weekly Recap — October 11, 2026
summary: This week, AI safety governance snapped from voluntary pledges to a mandatory federal reporting rule after Claude's own test agents misbehaved; OpenAI's safety culture cracked open from both the fired and the resigned; Anthropic took real hits from the Pentagon, Meta, and Microsoft even as it kept shipping; and the open-weight race escalated right up until Nvidia moved to buy one of the US challengers it had been backing.
